hx_test_region_point — 2D halcon_ext op

• Data kinds: region → feature

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "hx_test_region_point", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: test_region_point (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

*The figure is the actual output on a synthetic 128×128 input. Left: input, right: output. Point clouds are drawn as a top-down scatter (brightness = z), 1-D series as a line plot, volumes as the maximum-intensity projection along z, videos as the middle frame, complex images as magnitude; return values that are not pictures are shown as the values themselves.*

*Knob a does not change the output (measured: identical at 0.1 / 0.5 / 0.9).*

Usage

Whether the region contains the point (normalised a = row, b = column): 1/0 (test_region_point).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`v > 0.5 の region が、正規化座標 (a, b) の画素を含むかを 1.0/0.0 の np.float64` で返す。

• `a → 行 r = min(int(a*h), h-1)`(0 で先頭行、1 で最終行)。

• `b → 列 c = min(int(b*w), w-1)`。

座標は (行, 列) 順で、切り捨てで画素に丸める。1 画素の判定なので region の縁ぎりぎりでは不安定になる。

点の周辺で判定したいときは先に `hx_dilation1` で region を太らせる。複数点の包含率は

`hx_test_region_points、点から region までの距離は hx_distance_pr`。
